proof_anatomy.checked_direction_from_irrationality: For a fixed scaled tail, irrationality gives positive distance from the integer lattice. Choosing a sufficiently large Euler-multiple H converts that distance into a central residue gap at the prescribed basepoint.
proof_anatomy.checked_direction_to_irrationality: A hypothetical rational denominator fixes c and v; the supplied compatible Mersenne block then forbids the integral tail difference forced by denominator clearing.
proof_anatomy.genuinely_hard_step: Produce one strict centered gap for every c and positive odd v without assuming irrationality. No current finite scan, lock theorem, anchored certificate, or prime-support result supplies this universal quantifier.
proof_anatomy.natural_friction: The forced basepoint, Euler divisibility, strict endpoint width, and full quantifier order are load-bearing. A statement that residues eventually escape suppresses precisely the difficulty.
